bots.name: Welcome Guide
bots.greeting: Welcome, traveler! Follow the glowing path and I'll show you around.

bots.name: Help Desk
bots.greeting: Help Desk here. Ask me anything about the realm.

faq.answer: The Radio Club dance floor is next to Phoenix Radio. Check Destinations › Events for DJ nights.
Tap FLY or press F. Use Up/Down to change height.
MENU › Teleport or Destinations, or tap a spot on the World Map.
Tap the minimap (top-right) for the World Map. ◎ Me recenters it.
Talk opens chat. IC is in character; use (( )) for OOC.
Avatar changes your look; Wardrobe swaps outfits and attachments.
Ask a companion in Talk to build or dig where you're looking.
Combat only happens inside combat zones like Ember Arena.
MENU › Destinations › Events lists what's on.
AEC is the in-game currency (game-only). Your balance is in the top status bar.
Tap 'Skip tutorial' in the Welcome panel. You can return later from MENU › Welcome Island.

fallback: I'm not sure yet. Try words like fly, map, teleport, chat, combat, club or events.
